name: card-swipe-deck

frames.best_why: Shows the top card tilted mid-swipe with its SAVE stamp and the next card stacked behind.

tagline: Tinder-style deck of travel cards that fly off with a SAVE stamp.
summary: A stack of photo cards you drag left or right; past a threshold the top card tilts away with a coloured wash and a Save or Skip stamp, and the next slides forward.
appearance: A portrait photo card with a place name and trip line sits atop a slightly offset stack on black. Three round buttons below offer a red X, a reset arrow and a green heart.
behaviour: Dragging the top card tilts it around a low pivot and blooms a green SAVE stamp or red Skip stamp with a matching colour wash. Releasing past the threshold throws it off and slides the stack forward; below it the card springs back.
demo_content: Travel cards for Dolomites Italy, Lofoten Norway and Patagonia Chile with nights and price.
search_phrases: drag card to like or skip
deck of cards you can throw
use_when: Users pick through items one at a time, liking or skipping, more playfully than a grid.
avoid_when: A gesture deck hides everything but one card, and touch is the natural input; desktop relies on the buttons or keys.
customise: Pass an items array of content and ids plus labels, stack size, threshold and swipe callbacks; the card frame styling is in the source.
weight_why: Only a few cards are mounted with transform-driven stamps; no canvas or loop.

a11y.note: Arrow keys swipe and a live region counts cards, but the deck removes its focus outline and the stamps are decorative.

polish_why: Polished Tinder-style stack with convincing stamps and a springy settle.
title: Card Swipe Deck
